model_annotation: The pie chart, titled "儿童长新闻数量" (Children's Long-Form News Quantity), displays the distribution of long-form news articles across eight different categories, with each category represented by a colored slice and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark blue, represents "科学" (Science) at 21%. The second largest is "社会" (Society) at 20%, shown in orange. "榜样" (Role Models) accounts for 19% and is colored yellow. "环境" (Environment) is 14% and is brown, while "文化" (Culture) is also 14% and is teal. "政治" (Politics) is 6% and is green, "经济" (Economy) is 2% and is red, and "体育" (Sports) is 4% and is light blue. A legend at the bottom of the chart matches each category to its corresponding color. Each slice is labeled with its percentage value, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, starting with the "体育" slice at the top right.
